next_step_summary: PR #240 adds the first immutable, source-attributed, machine-readable historical snapshot of the 2017 residential-rental reform (Amendment No. 1 to the Rental and Loan Law) plus a statutory-snapshot maintenance README. The snapshot is a normalized engineering representation grounded to official Knesset source metadata, explicitly historical, and explicitly unsafe as current law without later effective-date overlays. It is stacked on merged PR #239, changes no runtime/provider/data flow, and keeps the current Question Engine implementation direction unchanged. active_track remains question-engine-development and next_step_id remains question-engine-question-inventory-v1.
